g.text: Armature — C4 Code / Go Package Map
Every production package is shown. Package arrows are direct first-party imports; cmd/armature fan-out is grouped by layer.
Build, test, and documentation support packages
Green = domain/state; blue = workflow; orange = governance
Purple = presentation; gray = infrastructure; rose = support
Arrow A → B means package A imports package B
No arrow implies no production first-party import
Standard library and third-party imports are intentionally omitted
